economic_hypothesis: The maximum-turnover down session in a stock's recent causal history records a large transfer of inventory at an objective cost anchor. If price then remains capped below that session's high and repeatedly trades below its volume-weighted cost, the first later liquid, high-location close above the anchor high may reveal that trapped supply has finally been absorbed. The pre-anchor 60-session high was already observable when the anchor formed and supplies a natural unfinished repair destination.

inherited: an objective price-memory structure exists before the signal
the signal confirms demand entering that structure
the destination is a pre-existing unfinished price path rather than an arbitrary fixed percentage
all charts are reviewed before no more than five causal rules are frozen
v26_methodological_inheritance.not_reused: No true gap, V13, V26, V27, collapse-zone, rolling support, industry shock, price-limit identity, or future pivot participates.

universe.signal_required: hard_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, not corporate_action_blocking

pre_existing_anchor.search_window: signal t-60 through t-10 market-session rows, inclusive
pre_existing_anchor.selection: the eligible same-lineage row with maximum turnover_fraction; earliest cal_idx breaks an exact tie
pre_existing_anchor.anchor_validity: hard_valid, current_valid, tradable, market-rule-valid, corporate-action-valid, and not corporate-action-blocking
pre_existing_anchor.seller_transfer: anchor coordinate step_return <= -3 percent and anchor close location <= 50 percent
pre_existing_anchor.anchor_vwap: raw amount / raw volume multiplied by the anchor coordinate_factor
pre_existing_anchor.age_rationale: At least ten market sessions separate anchor and signal so later behavior can represent absorption rather than the anchor bar itself. Sixty sessions bounds the economic memory without a lookback search.

absorption_history.path_validity: Every row from anchor+1 through signal must remain hard-valid, current-valid, market-rule-valid, corporate-action-valid, non-blocking, and on the frozen anchor/signal coordinate lineage; otherwise fail closed.
absorption_history.first_reclaim: No tradable same-lineage completed close from anchor+1 through signal-1 is above the frozen anchor coordinate high.
absorption_history.trapped_inventory_evidence: At least five tradable same-lineage completed closes from anchor+1 through signal-1 are below frozen anchor VWAP.
absorption_history.target: Maximum valid tradable same-lineage coordinate high in anchor-60 through anchor-1, fixed before the anchor formed.

outcome_blind_coverage_audit.comment: Counts are data-readiness evidence only. No entry, exit, target hit, or future return was read. The first draft count omitted an explicit all-path validity guard; this guard was added before Stage A identity materialization or any outcome attachment and reduced counts without consulting payoff.

frozen_translation_for_chart_labels.entry: first legal non-upper-limit open strictly after signal t and no later than t+3 market sessions
frozen_translation_for_chart_labels.entry_headroom_gate: The fixed A67 target must imply at least +4 percent net return after 40 bp round-trip cost at the executable entry; otherwise no trade.
frozen_translation_for_chart_labels.profit_fill: known target may fill intraday beginning with the first legally sellable session; never on the entry bar
frozen_translation_for_chart_labels.time_stop: after 20 held market sessions, exit at the first later legal sellable open
frozen_translation_for_chart_labels.limits_suspensions_corporate_actions: preserve accepted fail-closed execution and coordinate-lineage semantics

chart_questions: Did the anchor represent forced seller transfer or mature distribution near a peak?
Was the period below anchor VWAP an orderly base, continued deterioration, or repeated failed reclaim?
Did the first anchor-high reclaim begin a new repair leg or merely retest overhead supply?
Was the pre-anchor target corridor sparsely occupied or crowded with intervening supply?
Did causal market direction and acceleration alter the mechanism without using a future bull/bear label?
